id: title:haacked:keep database timeouts out of the python fast retry

review.posthog_relevance: Postgres database timeout handling and gRPC retry prevention
review.reason: Adds metadata key 'x-db-timeout' to distinguish Postgres statement or lock timeouts from other gRPC errors, and updates implementation to exclude these timeouts from retryable gRPC errors. This prevents unnecessary retries for database-specific failures, improving reliability and resource utilization.
review.uncertainty: Exact metadata key and its origin cannot be fully verified without the Rust implementation or shared metadata key definition; unverified outcomes include actual production behavior and complete absence of false positives.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the Rust implementation or the shared metadata key definition, so the exact metadata key and its origin cannot be verified. No score is assigned.
